questions.stem: The patient's blood pressure is 120/80 mm Hg. Four different sphygmomanometers measure his BP, each with 3 readings. Match the sphygmomanometers with their respective accuracy and precision parameters. Sphygmomanometer readings Accuracy and Precision parameters 1. 120/80, 120/80, 120/80 a. Precise but inaccurate 2. 140/96, 108/62, 96/82 b. Imprecise but accurate 3. 140/96, 140/96, 140/96 c. Precise and accurate 4. 122/82, 120/80, 118/78 d. Imprecise and inaccurate
